blockWrapper: div.<name>-wrapper around the block; section gains .<name>-container
buttonizationRule: decorateButtons() buttonizes `p a[href]` only when the link is wrapped in authored <strong> (primary), <em> (secondary) or both (accent) and the paragraph holds nothing but the link; bare links stay links

chrome.header: loadHeader(body > header) → blocks/header, fetches /nav via loadFragment (nav metadata override)
chrome.footer: loadFooter(body > footer) → blocks/footer, fetches /footer via loadFragment (footer metadata override)

fonts: none — source loads no web font; fonts.css has no @font-face and scripts.js loads no fonts
